notes: 02: titleFetcher only fetches page <title>; no description, favicon, or preview image collected. 03: title editable via Rename after save only; no pre-save edit step and no description field. 04: PATCH edits title and tags only; url, description, and note are not editable (description/note not modelled). 07: cards show title, url/host, and tags but no description or favicon. 12: search haystack is title+url+tags; note and description not searched (not stored). 14: no #tag search syntax; typing #x does not match tags. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 20: no multi-select or bulk actions. 21: no bulk-apply-to-filtered-collection. 22: list is fixed newest-first with no user-selectable sort key. 23-32: no markdown notes, HTML/PDF snapshot, Internet Archive, archive/unarchive, archived-list view, bundles, Netscape import/export, or display settings implemented.
